_note: Gas, electric energy or water for the household: bought from an outside agency, "the amount paid by the employer to the agency"; from the employer's own resources, "the manufacturing cost per unit incurred by the employer" — both entered as an amount — less the employee's payment (D-120; rulebook PERQ-UTIL-2026). Provided by the employer, a benefit or amenity — salary only for a specified employee (s.17(1)(c)); meeting the employee's own obligation, salary for everyone (s.17(1)(f)) — D-120 C1a, OQ-10. TY 2026-27: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.15(4) Table III (Gazette 271092, p.1544). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.3(3)–(6) (consolidated rule 3, p.3). Every regime.
